name: Security turnstile
description: A face-scanning security turnstile: a white pedestal with a black glass top, a red line, a scan camera, and two clear glass wings, closed.

made_with.settings: smart topology, main view only, textured, PBR

notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py. 2.20 m long with its wings 2.10 m across, larger than the brief. Meshy made the glass wings opaque, so Claude cut them away by position and put in real glass panels (alpha 0.25). --glow 2: the red line glows.
